summary.prose: The work is in the JetBrains plugin only. First the daemon gateway learns to carry config.write's full answer and to call models.definitions, models.check and models.approve/reject. Then the Model tiers model and section are rebuilt on those definitions with daemon-identical tier resolution and whole-tier saves, a Check model… dialog and a single restart offer are added, and the per-repo settings lose their tier fields. A sandbox-IDE walk against the live daemon closes it.

tasks.title: Carry config.write's restartRequired, reason and detail through SaveResult
tasks.summary: SaveResult.Saved gains restartRequired, Rejected gains detail; configWrite reads data.reason/detail/restartRequired; the four matchers use `is SaveResult.Saved` and show the detail.
acceptanceChecks: config.write {ok:true, restartRequired:true} gives Saved(restartRequired=true); {ok:false, reason:'rejected-model', detail} gives Rejected with both
ModelTiersSection, PerRoleSection, PerRepoSection and InsrcSettingsConfigurable compile and show the detail in their failure lines

tasks.title: Let a caller keep result.error in the reply
tasks.summary: A default DaemonRpc.call(method, params, resultErrorIsFailure) overload; UnixSocketDaemonRpc overrides it and parse takes the flag.
acceptanceChecks: parse(reply, resultErrorIsFailure=false) of a reply whose result has error, checkId, runs=false and efforts returns ok=true with all of them in data
The two-argument call and default parse behave exactly as before (existing UnixSocketDaemonRpcParseTest cases pass)

tasks.title: Gateway calls for the model definitions, check and decision
tasks.summary: Kotlin DTOs for models.definitions, ModelCheckOutcome, ModelDecisionResult and DaemonFailure; DaemonGateway.modelDefinitions/checkModel/decideModel with failure classification; DaemonGatewayService forwarding; stubs in the four test fakes.
acceptanceChecks: A fake answer parses into families/models/efforts/aliases/installed/tierDefaults/toolLoopModel/defaultFamily; malformed entries are skipped; no families is Failed(Other)
DaemonUnavailableException is NotRunning ('not running or the connection was lost'); 'unknown method: ' is OlderDaemon saying to update; other errors are Other with the text
checkModel reads through the result-error-preserving call: a not-run check keeps checkId, efforts and error; an invalid-params reply (no checkId) is Failed(Other)
decideModel maps ok / reason+detail / failure; DaemonGatewayService forwards all three

tests.name: jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/daemon/ModelDefinitionsGatewayTest.kt: modelDefinitions/checkModel/decideModel parsing and failure classification over a fake DaemonRpc

tasks.title: ModelTiersModel choices and current tier from the definitions
tasks.summary: ModelTiersModel takes the definitions instead of per-provider lists: runner, model (alias / not installed labels) and effort choices come only from them; the current tier is resolved as the daemon does (tierSetting + parseTiering + dropped effort); PROVIDERS removed.
acceptanceChecks: Offers exactly a fake answer's families, models (alias / not installed labels) and efforts; no PROVIDERS constant and no runner/model literal

Parity: runner+model without effort shows none; unset tier shows the default family's default and its effort; effort leaf alone applies to the default; runner alone is ignored; model '' is unset; an unaccepted stored effort shows '' with the note and is not dirty

tasks.title: ModelTiersModel edits and whole-tier writes
tasks.summary: Runner switch takes the family default (tierDefaults, else toolLoopModel, else first model); a model change clears an effort the new model does not take; collectWrites emits one whole-tier write per dirty tier and refuses a dirty tier whose model is not listed.
acceptanceChecks: Switching to a local family without tierDefaults takes toolLoopModel and ''
A model change to one that does not accept the current effort clears it to ''
One {runner, model, effort} write at ['models','tiers',tier] per dirty tier; an effort-only edit of a not-listed model is refused

tasks.title: Wire the Model tiers section and settings page to the definitions
tasks.summary: InsrcSettingsConfigurable and ModelTiersSection read modelDefinitions() instead of listModels per provider; a failure shows the classified message with no editable rows; Refresh re-reads; apply() sends the whole-tier writes; the source scan is updated.
acceptanceChecks: No settings source calls listModels or names a provider list
A Failed definitions answer shows its message and Refresh retries
Apply writes whole tiers and keeps a failed tier's pending edit with the reason and detail

tests.name: jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/settings/ModelTiersWiringSourceScanTest.kt: no PROVIDERS, no listModels use, no family or model literal in settings sources; definitions read on open and Refresh

tasks.title: Check model dialog with approve, reject and restart
tasks.summary: A Check model… action opens a DialogWrapper over a headless check controller: CLI family and model id, the check off the EDT with progress, runs / input limit / per-effort verdict and evidence, Approve with ticked non-rejected efforts or Reject, then a Restart daemon offer (DaemonLifecycleCommandRunner.run(RESTART) confirmed by daemonStatus) that re-reads the definitions.
acceptanceChecks: Approve is disabled when the model did not run; Reject still works with that check's id
Approve sends only ticked, non-rejected efforts; unknown-check offers Check again; Refused/Failed show the daemon's reason and detail
After a confirmed restart the definitions are re-read and the model is offered; the flow never writes a tier

tests.name: jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/settings/ModelCheckFlowTest.kt: approve disabled when not run; reject with the check's id; only ticked non-rejected efforts sent; unknown-check offers check again; no tier write; restart confirmed then definitions re-read

tasks.title: One restart offer after an Apply that needs it
tasks.summary: SettingsSection.takeRestartRequired() (default false); the writing sections set it from Saved(restartRequired); InsrcSettingsConfigurable.apply() collects it with the generic writes' results and, after the background loop, offers one Restart daemon prompt (also when other writes failed), reusing t6's restart helper.
acceptanceChecks: Exactly one prompt when any section or generic write returned restartRequired, none otherwise
With a failure and a restartRequired success, the prompt comes first, then the ConfigurationException listing the failure
Prompt and restart run outside the background save loop

tests.name: jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/settings/InsrcSettingsConfigurableRestartTest.kt: one prompt when any write needed a restart, also with a failure; none otherwise

tasks.title: Per-repo settings without tier fields
tasks.summary: Remove per-tier state, fields and writes from PerRepoOverridesModel and PerRepoSection, and the tiers parse from the gateway's per-repo read; update InsrcSettingsConfigurableTest, PerRepoOverridesModelTest and PerRepoOverridesGatewayTest.
acceptanceChecks: Per-repo settings show and write only coreFloor and role tiers
No setTierField, TierField or per-tier runner/model field remains in the per-repo code
A tiers leaf in models.byRepo is ignored
